name: Mevan Wijewardena
bio: Mevan is a student from University of Moratuwa in Sri Lanka. Currently he is reading for the bachelor of engineering in electronic and telecommunications degree. He is here in AHLab for a six month internship. Mevan is interested in areas such as machine learning, image processing, data structures and algorithms.

publications.title: MAGHair: A Wearable System to Create Unique Tactile Feedback by Stimulating Only the Body Hair
publications.citation: Boldu, R., Wijewardena, M., Zhang, H. and Nanayakkara, S.C., 2020, October. MAGHair: A Wearable System to Create Unique Tactile Feedback by Stimulating Only the Body Hair. In 22nd International Conference on Human-Computer Interaction with Mobile Devices and Services (pp. 1-10).
